title: Business Office Rule on Posting Pre-K Tuition Charges
content:
## Rule

- **When tuition posts.** Under Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, tuition posts on the first day of each month listed in the type's tuition billing months for an enrollment on Pre-Kindergarten (Tuition-Based), and the first month's tuition posts on the registration date.
- **Open enrollments only.** Tuition posts only on an enrollment in status provisional or enrolled; the status on the enrollment record decides.
- **Amount.** The charge is the type's monthly tuition, less the tuition sibling discount percentage when the household sibling-discount term gives the child a sibling discount. A first month whose entry date falls on or after the type's half-month start day is charged the half-month rate percentage of that amount, and every other month is a full month. Each charge records whether it is a full month or a half month and whether the sibling discount was applied.
- **Rounding.** The amount is rounded to the nearest cent, half a cent rounding up.
- **Due date and late fee (no longer in force).** The former clause that tuition is due by the due day of the month and that, when any part of a month's tuition is still unpaid after the due day, one tuition late fee posts the set number of days after it, payments being applied to the oldest open charge first, is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current late-fee basis.
- **Types without tuition.** Enrollment types with a monthly tuition of 0.00 post no tuition.

The monthly tuition, billing months, half-month start day, half-month rate and sibling discount percentage are set in the board-approved fee schedule.

## How a charge is figured

The monthly tuition is multiplied by the share left after the sibling discount (100 percent less the discount percentage when the discount applies, otherwise 100 percent), then multiplied by the proration share (the half-month rate for a qualifying first month, otherwise 100 percent), and the product is rounded to the nearest cent once, at the end.

## Worked example (hypothetical figures, not the district's tuition)

Take a hypothetical monthly tuition of 320.00, a 10 percent sibling discount and a 50 percent half-month rate with the half month starting on the 16th:

| Case | Sibling discount applies | Entry date in the first month | Charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| first child, first month, entry on the 3rd | no | before the 16th | 320.00, a full month |
| second child, first month, entry on the 16th | yes | on the 16th | 320.00 less 10 percent is 288.00; half of that is 144.00 |
| second child, any later month | yes | not a first month | 288.00, a full month |
| first child, first month, entry on the 15th | no | before the 16th | 320.00, a full month |

superseded_clauses: Tuition is due by tuition_due_day of the month; when any part of a month's tuition is still unpaid after the due day, one tuition_late_fee posts tuition_late_fee_offset_days after it, payments being applied to the oldest open charge first.
